notes.title: October 2023 Major Patch
notes.content:
I'm sorry! I became lazy because I was so relieved that the game was released after a major patch in September.
We are currently updating to address various inconveniences over the past month since launch. Bugs are also being fixed.
Let me briefly tell you what we are doing.

1. Bug fixes.
1_1. Fixed bug related to retry.
1_2. Store-related bug fixes.
1_3. Fixed bugs related to maps.
1_4. Fixed bug with item description.
1_5. Fixed bug related to stats when changing items.
1_6. Fixed bug related to gift boxes.
1_7. Various monster-related bug fixes.
1_8. Other bug fixes.

2. Update.
2_1. Changes related to retry.
2_2. Store-related changes.
2_3. Changes to NPC interaction.
2_4. Added pause function.
2_5. Changes related to monster dictionary.
2_6. Cool time and duration display added.
2_7. Various monster-related changes.
2_8. Quest-related changes.
2_9. Other changes.

We will strive to become a better Free For All. thank you
